provenance_events.description: A circa-2014 Hulk with box and papers sold for CHF 17,780. Recorded in the original currency; not included in the USD estimate.

The "Hulk" — green ceramic bezel, green sunburst dial — runs 2010-2020 as the most-cited modern Submariner variant. The combination of green dial and green bezel had no Submariner precedent; discontinuation in 2020 makes it the 2010s baseline.

Rolex launches the 116610LV "Hulk" at Baselworld 2010 — the first Submariner with a green ceramic bezel and a green dial. The Hulk becomes the most-cited modern Submariner variant for the Asian collector market through its 2010-2020 production run.

narrative.story: Launched alongside the black 116610LN in 2010, the LV paired a green sunburst dial with a green Cerachrom bezel — the first all-green Submariner, following the green-bezel-only 'Kermit' 16610LV. Collectors named it the Hulk for the color and the heavy maxi case. When Rolex dropped it in 2020 without a direct all-green successor, secondary prices moved sharply upward and have stayed above the black model's since.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial shifts with light from deep green to near-black; photographs oversell the effect. Discontinuation made 2019-2020-carded full sets the sought-after configuration.
